Slug variants 'nhava-sheva-business-park-pvt-ltd' and 'nhava-sheva-business-park-pvt' returned empty record tables (0 rows). volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com returned HTTP 403, so no export-side cross-check was possible.

The only address visible in trade data is 'FLOOR 5 A/WING AHURA CENTRE MAHAKALI CAVES ROAD ANDHERI (EAST)' (registered office) and the consignee address 'NHAVA SHEVA BUSINESS PARK PRIVATE LIMITED, CUSTOMS CODE (AE-1140805/F19185)' at JNPT SEZ. Web search was unavailable during this check (search backend connection refused), so domestic supply evidence could not be searched — status is unknown, not negative.
note: Declared HS codes 847150;851712;851713;851822 (computers/phones/routers) do NOT match the only observed customs activity: all 5 visible records are imports of lead-acid VRLA batteries under HS 85072000. Per project rules this is not a rejection ground — company stays in the base and the actual HS should be corrected to 85072000 (battery imports) with verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Role: appears to be an importer/trader (SEZ unit acting as consignee), not a manufacturer of the declared IT goods. No export shipments and no domestic supply traces found in accessible sources; the 10-record count on ImportKey is inbound only. Revenue and export volume: null — not public.
